purpose: Form language specification board showing pebble metaphor and proportion studies
prompt:
Professional industrial design form language specification board for an elderly AI companion device. Core metaphor: river pebble / smooth stone.

Layout: Form language board on warm cream background (#F5F0E8). Two rows of content.

Top row — "Form Metaphor Evolution" (left to right):
1. A photograph-style rendering of a smooth river pebble (natural, organic, warm gray-beige)
2. An arrow pointing to a simplified pebble silhouette in surface-cream #F5F0E8
3. An arrow pointing to the product form — a pebble-shaped device with fabric wrap (upper 2/3 in cream) and light oak wood base ring (bottom 1/3 in #C4A882), with a subtle amber glow ring (#E8B87A) at the junction. Height-to-width ratio 1.3:1.
4. Show 3 alternative form studies alongside: a slightly taller pebble variant, a wider/flatter pebble variant, and a gently tapered cylinder-with-rounded-top variant. All maintain the same organic, rounded, no-sharp-edges language.

Bottom row — "Proportion Studies":
Show technical diagrams of the selected form with:
- Overall height-to-width ratio: 1.3-1.5:1
- Base diameter to body ratio: 0.7:1
- Minimum corner radius: 8mm (highlighted with small radius callouts)
- Button diameter: 25mm minimum (shown on front face)
- LED ring position: upper third of body

All forms drawn with warm tones. No sharp edges anywhere. Text annotations in text-charcoal #3D3832. Humanist sans-serif typography.

Bottom annotation: "Non-animal, non-human, non-clinical. A warm object that feels like it belongs on a wooden shelf next to a ceramic cup."

Style: professional industrial design form study board, like pages from a Dieter Rams or Naoto Fukasawa design process document. Clean, systematic, warm.
